data.gender_notes: Ruksana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of grace, beauty and elegance who is delicate and precious like a jewel. Derived from the Arabic word 'Rukhsah' which means 'moon' and the Persian word 'Sana' which means 'rest' or 'calm'. The name Ruksana carries the meaning “Elegant, Beautiful, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Ruksana usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, beautiful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
